issue: New entry does not persist across page reload
actual: Added entry 'QA Test Entry' (Priority 7, Due Sep 1 2026, Completed) appeared immediately (count went 5->6), but after reloading the page (navigating to the same URL) the entry list reverted to the original 5 entries and the count read '5 entries' again.

evidence: Added field 'Notes' (type Text) via Fields dialog; it appeared as a new column in table view, as a card field in card view, and as a new input in the Add Entry form.

Created 'Card Test Entry' with Priority=9 (number), Due Date=Oct 5, 2026 (date), Completed=Yes (checkbox), Notes='Card view test note' (text). All values shown correctly and consistently in both table and card views.
Switched Cards->Table view; all 6 entries and their field values (including newly added ones) remained identical across the switch.
Empty 'Notes' field rendered as '—' consistently in both table cells and card fields for entries entry-1..entry-5; populated fields matched across views for the new entries.

Field type selector in Configure Fields dialog offers clearly labeled options Text/Number/Date/Checkbox. Add Entry form renders a text input for Text, a spinbutton for Number, a date textbox (value format YYYY-MM-DD) for Date, and a checkbox toggle with Yes/No label for Checkbox.

Entry form checkbox toggles between 'No'/'Yes' text. Table view renders a green check icon (class text-success) when true and a muted X icon (text-muted-foreground) when false. Card view shows literal 'Yes'/'No' text.

Priority field renders as native input[type=number]; attempting to type alphabetic text 'abc' into it was rejected by the browser input (Playwright error: 'Cannot type text into input[type=number]'). Earlier, entering valid numeric values (7, 9) saved and displayed correctly in both views.

Due Date field renders as native input[type=date]. Setting el.value='2026-02-30' (invalid, Feb 30) via JS was rejected by the browser (value reset to empty string), and Playwright itself refused to fill '02/30/2026' ('Malformed value'). Valid dates (2026-09-01, 2026-10-05) were accepted and saved correctly in earlier tests.

Clicking 'Task Name' column header sorted entries alphabetically ascending immediately and showed status 'Sorted by Task Name (ascending)'; clicking again toggled to descending order and updated the status to 'Sorted by Task Name (descending)'. App remained fully interactive throughout.

Sorted table by Task Name (asc then desc, confirmed order and status text). Switched to Cards; sort reset to default (no active sort), then set Cards sort to Priority (ascending) - card order became 1,1,2,2,3,9. Switched back to Table: table still showed 'Sorted by Task Name (descending)' with its own order intact, unaffected by the Cards sort change.

Across all sort operations (Task Name asc/desc in table, Priority asc in cards), entry count remained '6 entries' and every entry's field values (Priority, Due Date, Notes) were unchanged - only row order changed.

With no sort active, dragged (keyboard dnd-kit: Space/ArrowDown/Space) 'Design new landing page' from position 1 to position 3 in Table view -> order became entry-2,entry-3,entry-1,entry-4,entry-5,new. Separately reordered the same entry in Card view to a different position (entry-2,entry-3,entry-4,entry-5,entry-1,new). Switching back to Table view showed its own order (entry-2,entry-3,entry-1,...) unaffected by the Card view reorder, confirming each view keeps an independent manual order.

issue: No filter feature present in the application
actual: Searched the entire toolbar, table headers, and page DOM (button list and full innerHTML text search for 'filter') and found no filter control, filter dialog, or field-specific filter criteria UI of any kind. Only Sort, Search, view toggle, Add Entry, and Fields config controls exist.

issue: No filter feature present to test inclusion criteria
actual: No filter UI exists in the app (confirmed via DOM search), so no active criteria can be defined, and therefore filtering cannot include/exclude entries or be cleared as described.

evidence: Typing 'QUARTERLY' (uppercase) matched 'Prepare quarterly report' case-insensitively, filtered to 1 result, and status updated to '1 entry matching \"QUARTERLY\"'. Clicking the clear-search button restored the count to '6 entries'.

issue: Search matches internal raw values, not the formatted values shown to users
actual: Searching 'Jan 15' (the displayed Due Date format for 'Design new landing page') returned '0 entries matching'. Searching 'Yes' (the displayed Completed state for 3 entries) also returned '0 entries matching'. However, searching the raw internal ISO value '2026-01-15' returned '1 entry matching'. This shows the search indexes raw stored values (ISO date, boolean) instead of the formatted text ('Jan 15, 2026', 'Yes'/'No') visible to the user.

issue: No data import feature exists in the application
actual: Searched the Fields dialog, toolbar, and entire page DOM for an import control; found no file input (input[type=file] count = 0), no 'Import' button, and no import dialog. The only reference to importing is a static note text: 'Configure fields before importing data.' No actual import functionality is implemented, so schema-based import validation cannot be exercised.
